params.body:
The no-login page where the winner of a bidding rates the selling dealer (`GET ownvehicle/{vehicle}/addDealerVote`, R B1-5.11) read `$export_vehicle->vehicle_id` without checking that the id in the URL matched a bidding. An unknown id (a mangled or truncated mail link, a guessed URL) answered 500 with `Attempt to read property "vehicle_id" on null` (Nightwatch #82, once on production on 2026-11-26).

The lookup already includes trashed biddings, so a null here means the bidding does not exist. The page now answers 404, the same as its POST (`storeDealerVote`) already did. A valid link behaves exactly as before.

Test: `VoteRoutesCheckOwnershipTest::test_the_no_login_dealer_vote_for_an_unknown_bidding_is_a_404` covers an id past the last bidding and an id that is not base64. It failed with a 500 before this change.

Closes #1139
params.title: Rate-the-seller link for an unknown bidding answers 404 instead of 500
